notes: BITE-14: D-2 threshold lock v0.1 applied. Offline pilot uses local_char4_proxy; DC-3 cache policy remains offline-proxy labeled (provider billed not available). No Survive claims. Gate C confirmatory C1–C3 require billed T_total — offline proxy alone → insufficient_offline.

Q_definition.definition: task accuracy vs gold y_star; mean of binary correct
Q_definition.baseline: Q_baseline = Raw full context same task/model/effort
Q_definition.rubric: report separately if present; NOT used in Q(pi) >= Q_baseline - delta

policy_thresholds.N_real: licence-cleared; separate registration (synthetic preferred in v0.1)
policy_thresholds.multiple_comparison: confirmatory Holm; exploratory separate/unadjusted or FDR with explicit split

confirmatory_detail.C1: H2: under constraints, T_total improves vs Raw and one pre-specified best single-strategy baseline (adaptive chunking OR universal REDUCE, fixed pre-analysis)
confirmatory_detail.C2: H1: transparent m increments sequence prediction vs length-only
confirmatory_detail.C3: H6: net savings including overhead have positive sign

oracle_budget.note: legal sequences enumerate to at most 15 (ops at most once, non-empty)

cache_accounting.dc3_status: offline-proxy labeled; provider cache billing behavior not confirmed

policy_thresholds.offline_default: insufficient_offline when paid_api=false or T_total is local_char4_proxy (cannot honestly evaluate C1–C3)

constraints.formula: min_pi T_total(pi) s.t. Q(pi)>=Q_baseline-delta; Recall_vis>=rho_visible; Recall_rec>=rho_recoverable; Prov(pi)>=eta
constraints.Prov_definition: fraction of E items + R entries with required provenance fields complete (source_uri/version/span for E; locator+unit_id for R)
constraints.Recall_vis_definition: fraction of gold Ev_star units present in visible E
constraints.Recall_rec_definition: fraction of gold Ev_star in E or recoverable via R (recoverable=true + valid locator); note potential vs realized

dc_summary.DC-1: one API call = one ledger row
dc_summary.DC-3: cache policy consistent; offline pilot labels local_char4_proxy (provider billed TBD)
dc_summary.DC-4: count only actually sent text; no dual-use double count

estimate_sources.provider_usage: preferred when available; primary for confirmatory T_total
estimate_sources.local_char4_proxy: offline pilot ONLY; MUST label; not billed provider usage; cannot alone support Go
